subject: Proposed rotating demo windows for SilverWell technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@silverwell.com>, Marta Ruiz <m.ruiz@silverwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed rotating windows for next step

Hi Jordan / Marta —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap of what I heard:
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference performance and integration for SilverWell's document ingestion pipeline (HIPAA scanning).
- Success criteria: <20ms median token latency for short prompts, ability to host in VPC, audit logs for SOC2 evidence.
- Key stakeholders: Jordan (platform lead), Marta (security/compliance), and your infra team for the deep-dive.

Next step: technical deep-dive + integration demo. You mentioned the team is distributed (US / EU) and would prefer at least two windows to rotate so different time zones can attend over successive weeks. To simplify coordination, I put together a short list of rotating timebands (attached rw_proposed_timebands.csv) that cycle week-to-week:

- Week A: US morning (10:00–11:30 PT) — friendly for US east/coast and Americas
- Week B: EU afternoon (15:00–16:30 CET) — friendly for EMEA
- Week C: APAC evening (19:30–21:00 IST/HKT) — friendly for India/Asia attendees

This pattern keeps the core demo content consistent while letting regional engineers take lead for questions on their week. Suggested owners (internal): Ben -> US weeks, Vivek -> EU weeks, Hannah -> APAC weeks (rotating handoff note attached in the CSV).

Please take a look and tell me which of the three bands you prefer for the first deep-dive. I can also send calendar invites or a Doodle poll (linked) if you want to pick exact dates. Attached: rw_proposed_timebands.csv and a short mutual action plan draft.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rw_proposed_timebands.csv (CSV of candidate dates/timebands), SW-4729-mutual_action_plan.pdf (draft)
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@silverwell.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <m.ruiz@silverwell.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed rotating windows for next step

Thanks Hannah — good summary. Marta and I reviewed the bands you proposed and we like the rotation idea. Two quick asks before we lock a time:
1) Can you confirm expected demo length (we have ~90 minutes set aside).
2) Will the deep-dive include a short live run of our sample dataset? If so we need to coordinate credentials/VPC access in advance.

For the first session we prefer the EU afternoon slot if possible (Week B). Week B dates that work for us: Aug 25th or Sep 1st (CET).

If you can share the MAP PDF as an editable doc and a calendar invite with dial-in options, we can confirm internally.

Cheers,
Jordan

On Tue, Aug 17, 2026 at 00:12 Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see below)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@silverwell.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <m.ruiz@silverwell.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed rotating windows for next step

Great — appreciate the quick review.

Answers:
- Planned length: 75–90 minutes (45–60 min demo + 15–30 min Q&A / integration discussion).
- Live run: yes, we can run a short execution against a small slice of your sample dataset. For VPC access we will follow your security checklist — Vivek can coordinate credentials and a short pre-call tunnel test.

I updated the MAP to a docs link and attached the PDF for records (SW-4729-mutual_action_plan.pdf). To keep things moving I created two provisional invites in CET:
- Option 1: Tue Aug 25 15:00–16:30 CET (preferred)
- Option 2: Tue Sep 1 15:00–16:30 CET

If those look good Jordan / Marta, let me know which one to finalize and I will send a confirmed invite and an agenda. If you prefer Dadoodle/poll instead I can open that link.

Thanks —
Hannah

---
Attachment: SW-4729-mutual_action_plan.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@silverwell.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 08:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed rotating windows for next step

Looping in a couple of operational notes from the demo ops side:
- We should avoid heavy load on the live run. Suggest we stage a 5–10k token truncated set and run that against our pre-warmed instance to show latency numbers without exposing full data.
- Resource assignment: I can own the first EU week demo on Aug 25 (will be Ben on camera for architecture + infra). Vivek can lead the follow-up EU slot if we do another one. Hannah — can you confirm that Vivek is looped for the pre-call tunnel?

Also adding a small ask: could the SilverWell infra team provide a short list of sample queries they plan to run (2–3 examples)? That helps us tune the quant and batch settings ahead of the call.

Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hannah / Ben — thanks, that all sounds good. Aug 25 at 15:00 CET works for the team; please send the calendar invite (we'll attach sample queries to the invite so you have them before the pre-call).

Also confirming: preferring the staged small dataset approach for the live run. Marta will follow up with a short security checklist in a separate thread so Vivek can coordinate the tunnel/test.

See you Aug 25 — please send invite + agenda.

Jordan Lee
Platform Lead, SilverWell Health
